candidate: Enecom Hiroshima Data Center Existing Operations

selected_status.summary: October 1 dated operator notice addresses continuing Hiroshima DC customers and its active housing, cabling and managed-service arrangements. Together with the explicit continuity of existing customer contracts in the name-change terms and September 18 participant report of the August demonstration, it confirms existing operation as of the notice. This is a publication confirmation date, not an opening or completed construction date.

selected_locator.precision: Community-mapped data-center point used only as a locator for the named Enecom Hiroshima Building property. It does not identify particular data halls, an entrance, surveyed building limits or the whole East ward.
selected_locator.identity_review: OSM node 12514280890 is explicitly tagged as an Enecom data center and links the former EneWings service URL. That exact URL currently redirects 301 to the operator Hiroshima DC page, and housing terms page 36 explicitly confirm the old-to-new service name. The node lies within OSM way 1025347627 named Enecom Hiroshima Building. Enecom itself identifies Hiroshima ICT Center at this named building, Futabanosato 3-5-1, separately from headquarters and its 3-5-7 office. This is reviewed operator/service/map triangulation, not an operator-published coordinate, cadastral survey or data-hall boundary.
selected_locator.uncertainty_reason: The community-mapped source provides no measured horizontal accuracy. Decimal places are retained from the source and do not imply survey precision or known offsets to operating data halls.

acceptance_reason: The current operator service identity is tied through an exact former-service URL redirect and an explicit service-name-change clause to an OSM data-center node inside the operator-named host building. Original operator customer notice and maintained preexisting housing-service contracts support operation as of October 1; September 18 regional DC demonstration independently supplies recent service-use context. This fits the authorized labelled named-property marker scope.

date_review.selected_date_kind: dated operator publication confirming continuing named services
date_review.sept18_support: The September 18 release says demonstration began in August; no exact August day invented.
